title: Create:Aeronautics-Japanese Lang
description:
Create:Aeronauticsを日本語にするリソースパックです！

This is a resource pack that localizes “Create:Aeronautics” into Japanese!
body:
# Japanese
Create:Aeronauticsを日本語にするリソースパックです！ただ英語のままの部分が多いので気長にアップデートをお待ちください！今すぐに翻訳してほしい部分があったり翻訳が間違っているものを見つけたら作者の[X(Twitter)](https://x.com/Yuckey102)にDMしてくださると助かります！
# English
This is a resource pack that localizes “Create:Aeronautics” into Japanese! However, there are still many parts that remain in English, so please be patient while we work on updates! If there are any sections you’d like translated right away or if you find any translation errors, please send a DM to the author on [X](https://x.com/Yuckey102)—it would be a huge help!
